final: SELECT link_to_event, location, avg_ratio, rnk FROM (SELECT g.link_to_event AS link_to_event, g.location AS location, g.avg_ratio AS avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.location ORDER BY (g.avg_ratio IS NULL), g.avg_ratio DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT b.link_to_event AS link_to_event, e.location AS location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.location) g) ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk, link_to_event
